title: Positive-degree Zariski cohomology classes vanish locally
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $\mathcal G$ be an abelian sheaf on the small Zariski site $X_{\rm Zar}$ [def-sc-zariski-site]. For every integer $q>0$, every class $\xi\in H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G)$ [def-sc-zariski-cohomology], and every point $x\in X$, there is an open neighbourhood $U\subseteq X$ of $x$ such that the restriction of $\xi$ to $H^q(U_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G|_U)$ is zero.

source.place: Lemma 0GY0 (label lemma-gabber-criterion), line 14228, proof: the sentence that the Zariski cohomology class is locally trivial; the underlying derived-functor local-triviality argument is written as the statement here.
